name: Residencia Legal Temporaria -- MERCOSUR

requirements.blocker_text: Available to nationals of MERCOSUR member and associated states: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, Suriname, and Guyana -- with simplified documentation compared to the general temporary residency, and without needing to specify a purpose (work/study/other).

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate (past 5 years of residence)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years, renewable ONCE for an identical 2-year period only (not indefinitely renewable)

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Residencia Legal Temporaria MERCOSUR: eligible nationalities, simplified documents, 2yr+2yr renewal cap

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Unlike the general temporary residency, this route does NOT require specifying a work/study/other purpose -- open more broadly to regional nationals, hence categorised 'settled' rather than tied to one activity type. Notably, the source explicitly states this temporary MERCOSUR permit can be renewed only ONCE (for one further identical 2-year term) -- NOT indefinitely -- and the source did not describe an automatic conversion path to uy_permanent_residency_mercosur from this temporary status; leads_to_pr set false accordingly rather than assumed. A MERCOSUR national wanting permanent residency would apply to uy_permanent_residency_mercosur as its own separate process, per the source structure, though this was not explicitly confirmed either way.
